description: Source file for QUIC support in curl, implementing functions for QUIC context management, packet transmission and reception, and protocol version handling.

methods.name: void Curl_quic_ver(char * p,size_t len)
methods.description: Sets version string to indicate the QUIC protocol version in use.

methods.name: CURLcode vquic_ctx_init(struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx)
methods.description: Initializes the QUIC context, setting up packet buffers and timing.

methods.name: void vquic_ctx_free(struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the QUIC context.

methods.name: void vquic_ctx_update_time(struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx)
methods.description: Updates the timestamp for the last operation in the QUIC context.

methods.name: CURLcode send_packet_no_gso(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx,const uint8_t * pkt,size_t pktlen,size_t gsolen,size_t * psent)
methods.description: Sends a packet without GSO by splitting if necessary.

methods.name: CURLcode do_sendmsg(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx,const uint8_t * pkt,size_t pktlen,size_t gsolen,size_t * psent)
methods.description: Handles sending packets via sendmsg or send, with support for GSO and specific Linux features.

methods.name: send_packet_no_gso
methods.description: Sends packet data in chunks when GSO is disabled due to failure.

methods.name: CURLcode vquic_send_packets(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx,const uint8_t * pkt,size_t pktlen,size_t gsolen,size_t * psent)
methods.description: Sends packets, handling GSO restrictions and optional network simulation.

methods.name: CURLcode vquic_flush(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx)
methods.description: Flushes the send buffer, transmitting all queued packets.

methods.name: CURLcode vquic_send(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx,size_t gsolen)
methods.description: High-level API to transmit data, invoking flush.

methods.name: CURLcode vquic_send_tail_split(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx,size_t gsolen,size_t tail_len,size_t tail_gsolen)
methods.description: Splits the send buffer to handle tail data separately for sending.

methods.name: CURLcode recvmmsg_packets(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx,size_t max_pkts,vquic_recv_pkt_cb * recv_cb,void * userp)

methods.name: CURLcode recvmsg_packets(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx,size_t max_pkts,vquic_recv_pkt_cb * recv_cb,void * userp)
methods.description: Receives multiple packets using recvmsg() on BSD-like systems.

methods.name: CURLcode recvfrom_packets(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx,size_t max_pkts,vquic_recv_pkt_cb * recv_cb,void * userp)
methods.description: Receives individual packets using recvfrom() as fallback.

methods.name: CURLcode vquic_recv_packets(struct Curl_cfilter * cf,struct Curl_easy * data,struct cf_quic_ctx * qctx,size_t max_pkts,vquic_recv_pkt_cb * recv_cb,void * userp)
methods.description: High-level API to receive packets, choosing platform-specific methods.

methods.description: Creates and opens a log file in the directory specified by environment variable.
